glosses: boo!
Raillerie, ou huée de désapprobation, pour conspuer quelqu'un. → voir ouh et hou
Exclamation de tristesse ou de dégoût.

examples.text: – Oui, pauvre chérie. Un instant d'inattention et voilà le travail... Hein, ma pucinette, que voilà le travail, bouh bouh bouh...
Bouh, où t’es-tu sali comme ça ?

glosses: Exclamation pour surprendre ou effrayer quelqu'un, généralement quelqu'un que l'on connait.
Ausruf bei der Absicht, jemanden zu erschrecken

examples.text: Tina springt aus dem Gebüsch und schreit laut: „buh!“; Tom erschrickt fast zu Tode.
„Ganz seiner Mutter Ebenbild – wagt nicht, buh zu 'ner Gans zu sagen!“

glosses: Ausruf zum Ausdruck des Missfallens, der Unzufriedenheit

examples.text: Als der umstrittene Künstler die Bühne betrat, konnte man aus dem Publikum von allen Seiten „buh! buh!“ hören.

glosses: 2. Person Singular Imperativ Präsens Aktiv des Verbs buhen
A loud exclamation intended to scare someone. Usually used when one has been hidden from the target, and then appears unexpectedly.
An exclamation used by a member of an audience, as at a stage play or sporting event, to indicate derision or disapproval.

examples.text: I ask them to record their votes in my favour, and I ask, is there any man who will dare to call me a stranger (hear, hear, and booing)?

glosses: A derisive shout made to indicate disapproval.

examples.text: ...Hodgson headed down the tunnel with the boos of fans ringing in his ears after an eighth league defeat of the season...

glosses: To shout extended boos derisively.

examples.text: When he took the podium, the crowd booed.
Nobody booed and nobody clapped
Substitute Charlie Austin scored seven minutes into his Southampton debut as a lacklustre Manchester United were booed off at Old Trafford.

glosses: To shout extended boos at, as a form of disapproval or derision.

examples.text: The protesters loudly booed the visiting senator.

glosses: A close acquaintance or significant other.

examples.text: A tall, hooded young woman, clutching a newspaper article, delivered a note to the judge. “My name is Sunkist,” she wrote, “Lionel R. Harris is my boyfriend. Lewis shot my Boo and it was not self-defense . . . . Judge and jurors please listen to me I am 17 years of {age} and a good young lady and my Boo got killed for nothing.”

No matter what I do / All I think about is you / Even when I'm with my boo

examples.text: […] sexually promiscuous girl who smoked boo all day and socialized with junkies when she wasn't busy banging away in bed […]

glosses: To make a sound characteristic of cattle; to moo.

examples.text: I remember being in the Great Nut Walk and hearing Old Nettle 'booing' like a cow outside .
The cow's tether is put about the neck of the individual who has lost the cow, and he must go about booing like a cow till atonement is made.

glosses: A tail feather from an ostrich.

examples.text: Burglary.—On Monday night or early on Tuesday morning, some thieves effected an entrance into the premises of Mr. W. J.
